name: Drop / Raise Price for WooCommerce (over time)
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Drop / Raise Price for WooCommerce enables dynamic pricing that automatically adjusts product prices over time in customizable increments.

This plugin enables store owners to configure product prices to increase or decrease at fixed intervals by specified amounts or percentages. For example, you can set a product to drop by $10 or 5% every hour – this creates a sense of urgency and encourages faster purchasing decisions by offering an alternative to traditional countdown sales and limited-time offers.

Features

  • Automated price adjustments over time
  • Option to decrease or increase prices
  • Supports fixed amount or percentage-based changes
  • Customizable time intervals (hourly, daily, etc.)
  • Countdown timer showing time until next price change
  • Product-level pricing controls for flexibility
  • Drives urgency and boosts conversions through dynamic pricing
  • Alternative to classic flash sale countdowns

Use Cases

  • Clearance sales with progressive price drops
  • Launch promotions that reduce prices incrementally
  • Early-bird pricing that increases closer to event dates
  • Inventory liquidation with scheduled discounts
  • Creating urgency for seasonal or limited-time products

Support

You can contact us at our website wpgenie.org if you have problems or questions. Complete plugin documentation is here.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or greater

Setup

This section describes how to install Drop / Raise Price for WooCommerce (over time) plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WordPress user list.

If you have any problems contact us at https://wpgenie.org/
